Your holdings: SOXL (-27.16%) and SPAL (-24.89%) are deep in the red, flagged "SELL," and are leveraged. These need immediate attention, especially with margin amplifying drops. CRWD (+54.37%) is a strong performer.

Watch: Keep an eye on Treasury yield movements and any escalation in geopolitical events. Also, monitor the stops on your leveraged positions.

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management on your leveraged, losing positions, while selectively looking for opportunities in strong tech names.
